messages.subject: [NMOF-news] NMOF 0.24-0 on R-Forge
messages.body_plain:
v0.24-0  (2012-04-11)

   o Added function 'resampleC': allows to sample with replacement from
     arbitrary numeric vectors (ie, samples) and making the these samples
     (rank) correlated.

   o 'DEopt' and 'PSopt' now have an argument 'algo$minmaxConstr'. If
     TRUE, 'algo$min' and 'algo$max' become constraints. These
     constraints are implemented through an internal repair function
     that is called before any user-defined repair function.

-- 
Enrico Schumann
Lucerne, Switzerland
http://nmof.net

messages.subject: [NMOF-news] NMOF 0.25-0 on R-Forge
messages.body_plain:
v0.25-0  (2012-04-20)

   o All the R-code examples from the book are now available
     in the package through function 'showExample'; eg,
     'showExample("equations.R")'
     (The scripts are stored in subdirectory 'book'.)

   o A first draft of the 'NMOF Manual' is available from
     http://enricoschumann.net/NMOF.htm . The manual's code
     examples are collected in file 'NMOFman.R' (in subdirectory
     'NMOFex'). The manual supersedes 'Examples and Extensions for
     the NMOF package'.

   o The unit tests on specific TA applications (minimum variance,
     tangency portfolio) have been removed; the code was added to
     the manual.


-- 
Enrico Schumann
Lucerne, Switzerland
http://nmof.net
